produces: five-forces summary, competitor list w/ evidence links, JTBD-landscape verdict

mission_deliverables.artifact: the five-forces record itself (docs/issue-<n>/reports/market-analysis.md), already required by required_fields
mission_deliverables.fit_criterion: every force's evidence field names a checkable source (a tracked competitor entry, a dated external reference) — not a bare assertion; reuses the spec's own reference_resolution rule

mission_deliverables.artifact: docs/issue-<n>/reports/market-analysis/competitor-tracking.md (a maintained list of tracked competitor entries the evidence field's reference_resolution rule resolves against)
mission_deliverables.fit_criterion: at least one entry per force where the assessment is medium/high, so 'evidence' has something concrete to point at

record_spec.outcome_mission: the target project's market position is assessed against real, current competitive evidence — not a template filled with placeholder judgment.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: assessment is recomputed from current evidence at each market review, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: evidence, when it cites a competitor, must resolve to an actual tracked competitor entry — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

use_when.board_condition: a market entry or strategy decision is proposed AND no market-analysis record exists yet covering all five forces

need_detector.condition: a product-discovery or pricing record exists on the branch (a market-facing decision was made) AND no market-analysis record exists yet covering all five forces
need_detector.false_positive_bound: a repo with no product-discovery/pricing record at all never fires — no market-facing decision on the branch -> silent, unconditionally

record_spec.verified_by: requirements-engineering — market-analysis never grades its own mission_deliverables, same account-differs-from-producer basis as content-design (requirements-engineering never authors a market-analysis record)

use_when: product 스펙 확정 후, 경쟁 구도가 걸린 결정일 때
